help.equipment: Columns added to equipment managed by the target department of your department admin role (sub-departments excluded). Used in equipment lists, equipment management, Excel and diagrams; the columns start hidden. Values are edited by people who handle the equipment.
help.personnel: Columns added to personnel of the target department of your department admin role (sub-departments excluded). Shown only in Department ▸ People and Personnel management; members of that department edit values in the people table's edit dialog.

noDepartment: You have no department admin role, so you cannot create extra attributes.
loadFailed: Could not load extra attributes. Please try again.
name: Attribute name
cancelConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Cancel without saving?
deleted: Deleted the "{name}" attribute. You can restore it from its revision.
kindLocked: This attribute has values, so its value type cannot change. Create a new attribute and delete this one instead.
deleteConfirm: Deleting "{name}" removes {n} value(s). Delete it? (You can restore it from its revision.)
revisionsHelp: A revision is kept each time an attribute is added, edited, deleted or restored (latest 20). Restore a single attribute with its values from a delete revision.

actions.DEPT_DELETE: All attributes deleted with the department

restoreHelp: The attribute comes back as the same attribute; values return only to equipment or people whose department has not changed since. Diagram sharing stays off.
otherSemicolon: Checkbox "Other" text can't contain ; (it separates options in Excel).
noneDefined: This department has no extra attributes.
fileHelp: Any file except executables (exe, msi, bat, cmd, com, scr, ps1, vbs, js, jar, sh), up to 10 MB each. No limit on the number of files.

problems.nameParen: An attribute name cannot end with parentheses (it would clash with the multi-department column name "Name(Department)").
problems.optionSemicolon: Checkbox option names cannot contain ; (the Excel separator).

errors.ATTRIBUTE_CONFLICT: Another admin changed the attributes first. Reloaded; please edit again.
errors.ATTRIBUTE_DUPLICATE: This department already has an attribute with that name.
errors.ATTRIBUTE_KIND_LOCKED: An attribute with values cannot change its value type.
errors.ATTRIBUTE_RESTORE_CONFLICT: Cannot restore (it is already alive, or a type with values would change).
errors.ATTRIBUTE_NOT_OF_DEPARTMENT: This is not an extra attribute of this department.
errors.FILE_NOT_TEMP: Some files are too old or cannot be used. Remove them and upload again.
errors.PERSONNEL_EDIT_CONFLICT: Someone else changed it first. The list was reloaded; close this dialog and edit again.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: No permission. Only the department admin of that department edits its attributes.
errors.UNKNOWN: Could not process the request. Please try again later.
